profile.headline: dev
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with 20 years experience, mostly in electronic trading.  I've designed and built all aspects of trading software, managed teams, expanded the firm's global footprint, and helped grow the company from a few people in an apartment to 100+ employees.  I love a challenge.

I have proficiency in C#.  I've managed large projects where teams were primarily focused on high performance C++ development.  I contributed to those projects as well.

positions.title: Director of Strategy Engineering, Equity Partner
positions.description:
Designed and built strategy frameworks and algorithms with a focus on rapid development and ease of use.
Designed and built several highly efficient front end applications ranging from real time trading to analytical tools.
Managed a team of strategy developers that built all the algorithms the firm traded.
Helped in business development as the firm grew into other markets, specifically Asia.
Helped grow the firm from a team of seven people to over a hundred by being involved in hiring and interviewing.
